version: '3.8' services: signal-tower: image: signaltower/agent:latest container_name: signal-tower ports: - "8080:8080" environment: - MARKETS=sh000001,sz399001,sh000300 - CHANNEL=wechat - WECHAT_WEBHOOK=https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/... - PUSH_MORNING=true - PUSH_CLOSE=true restart: always
